alt: Overhead view of a red-signalled intersection: one car stops with its bumper on the painted limit line, a second car in the kerb lane waits with its right indicator on, and a car on the other approach, which has no limit line, stops short of the crosswalk while cross traffic moves.

alt: Driver's view while turning at a corner in late afternoon light, with two people still walking across the crosswalk ahead and a pedestrian signal showing an orange raised hand beside the number one.

Overhead view of one through street with three side streets joining it: the first has a crosswalk and a limit line, the second only a crosswalk, and the third no markings at all with a building on the corner.
